text:
alex: Heads-up — we're getting a spike of 503s from Hosted inference starting ~12:03 UTC. Affected customer: finance-api-prod, ~30% of requests failing.
sam: Seeing same in dashboards, p95 latency is fine but error-rate jump on /v1/generate -> upstream runnner exit 137 in logs.
maria: Any correlation with recent deploy? I don't see a canary swap. No deploys in the last 2 hours.
ops-bot: ALERT: hosted-infer-pool-4 instance 10.2.1.45 reported GPU silent reset, container exit code 137, restarted (autoeviction). Ref: https://internal.monitor/alerts/675432
alex: attaching truncated stderr from worker: ```
[2026-03-18T12:03:01Z] infer-runner[pid=4521]: nvml: GPU 0: silent_reset detected
[2026-03-18T12:03:01Z] infer-runner[pid=4521]: Killed by signal 9 (SIGKILL) during toolcall: model_call_loop
[2026-03-18T12:03:01Z] infer-runner[pid=4521]: dumping last 4KB of kv-cache...no dump
``` 
sam: That looks like a driver-level reset, but the pattern only appears for requests that include toolcall payloads (external tool call). Could be a specific kernel path hitting an NV driver bug.
maria: CS flagged customers seeing auth retries too — customer sees 503 then client retries hit billing quota spike. cs_lead: they started an on-call ticket; need customer-facing note asap.
jun: I can reproduce locally with a long prompt + toolcall combo on the same quantized model. Steps:
1) send request with context ~65k tokens
2) include tool-call header: {"x-tool":"pdf-extract"}
3) QPS ~5 over same connection
Result: GPU reset within 30–90s.
jun: attaching repro command: ```bash
for i in {1..6}; do 
  curl -s -X POST "https://hosted.redwood/api/v1/generate" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"prompt":"<long prompt>","tool_call":{"name":"pdf-extract"}}' &
done
wait
```
oncall_eng: nice repro. Can you capture nvml logs and full dmesg from the worker? I'll push a hotfix to route toolcalls off this pool while we debug.
alex: I've added fallback policy: route toolcall requests to coldpool-2 (non-quant machines) for that customer. Rolling now.
ops-bot: ROUTING: fallback-policy applied to finance-api-prod toolcall route, 100% -> coldpool-2. Start: 12:11 UTC.
cs_lead: Sending interim note to customer: "We're investigating intermittent 503s impacting toolcall-based requests; we've applied routing to mitigate and will follow up with a root-cause update." Waiting on link for postmortem.
sam: For triage: collect NVML logs (+/proc/driver/nvidia/), coredumps, and runner logs around the crash. Also check kernel oops in dmesg for GPU page-faults.
jun: I captured a small trace, nvml shows ECC correctable errors rising before reset. Might be hardware drift but only on one GPU model (A100-40GB-older-firmware).
maria: Are we seeing any packet-level auth failures? CS reported duplicate billing events when clients retried. ops: set idempotency header guidance to reduce duplicate billable events until we fix.
oncall_eng: Recommended mitigations:
- Keep fallback routing for toolcalls for 24h
- Add guardrail: reject requests with context > 60k tokens on quantized pool (500ms validation path)
- Schedule hardware swap for affected host and collect vendor logs
- Create postmortem with timeline and cost impact
alex: I'll open incident ticket and tag hw-svc and drivers. Assigning to sam + jun for immediate triage and to infra for HW swap.
cs_lead: Also cc billing-safety to reconcile duplicates. I'll handle customer comms.
sam: Quick debug note: disabling KV prefetch reduced resets in local repro. Might be interaction between KV prefetch + toolcall heavy context. Worth bisecting in runtime.
jun: I'll run a bisect on prefetch toggle across a small pool tomorrow and collect reproducer traces.
maria: Thanks all. If anyone sees new clusters of 503s, ping here and escalate to paging list.
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-2254, responders: sam, jun, oncall_eng. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-2254
alex: closing loop — mitigations live, customers notified, triage in progress.
